purpose: Define replayable low-frequency DBLP retry state and conditional fallback closure without rewriting the historical v1.0 protocol.

g0_seed: normalized title exact match or canonical DOI exact match

closure.closed_with_fallback: three rounds exhausted and every unresolved query has qualified fallback; advisory only
closure.closed_blocked: three rounds exhausted and at least one unresolved query lacks qualified fallback; hard blocker
closure.unresolved_missing_page: per-query disposition, not automatically a global C1 blocker
